title: Chris Evans clarifies Captain America's role in Doomsday
body_md:
Chris Evans is returning to the Marvel Cinematic Universe as Steve Rogers in Avengers: Doomsday, but his comeback does not mean he is reclaiming the Captain America mantle. A report published on November 26, 2026, describes Evans as wanting to clarify the distinction for Marvel fans who still address him as Cap. Anthony Mackie's Sam Wilson remains the current Captain America.

For much of the Infinity Saga, Steve Rogers was a central figure in Marvel's interconnected superhero films. His conclusion in Avengers: Endgame established a transition to another generation when he passed his shield to Sam Wilson. The Falcon and the Winter Soldier subsequently explored Sam's relationship with that responsibility, and Captain America: Brave New World placed Mackie's character at the center of his own theatrical adventure.

Footage from Doomsday offers a visual indication that Marvel intends to preserve that distinction. According to the report, Rogers appears in ordinary clothing and is shown wielding Mjolnir, while Wilson continues to carry the familiar Captain America shield. The footage does not establish every aspect of their roles in the finished film, but it provides a useful distinction between Steve's return and Sam's ongoing identity.

That distinction is particularly relevant for a crossover built around familiar faces and multiple generations of Marvel characters. Bringing Evans back allows the franchise to reconnect with audiences who followed Rogers through the Infinity Saga without necessarily undoing the developments that established Wilson as his successor. How the two heroes interact, and how their different experiences shape their decisions, remain questions for the movie itself.

The latest trailer has also attracted attention for its depiction of Cyclops addressing the X-Men with his signature call. Doomsday is expected to bring together several superhero teams, including the Avengers, the New Avengers, the Fantastic Four and the X-Men, against Doctor Doom, played by Robert Downey Jr. The scale of that ensemble makes the balance between returning characters and newer protagonists an important storytelling challenge.

The report also discusses audience expectations for emotional stakes comparable to Infinity War and Endgame. Speculation about character deaths is not confirmation of any particular outcome, however, and the available material does not establish which heroes will survive.

Ultimately, Evans returning as Steve Rogers and Mackie continuing as Captain America are compatible developments. The film's opportunity lies in exploring the history shared by the two characters while respecting the individual journeys that brought them to this point.
excerpt: Steve Rogers returns in Doomsday while Sam Wilson remains Captain America.
